channel.title: Etelwardo Sigismondi — Press releases
channel.description: Parliamentary activity, dossiers on Abruzzo's issues, press releases and press coverage of Senator Etelwardo Sigismondi. Verified data, official sources.

item.title: Electoral law, preferential votes are back: “the will of the people restored”
item.description: Preferential votes return in the electoral law promoted by the centre-right. For Sigismondi it is a historic turning point: more stability for governments and, after thirty-five years, Italians’ right to choose their representatives directly.

item.title: Four years of the Meloni government: over three hundred people from Abruzzo at the Bari rally
item.description: On 4 September 2026, the day the Meloni government becomes the longest-serving in republican history, Sigismondi claims its results and announces Abruzzo’s participation in the Bari rally: over three hundred people and six coaches.

item.title: Abruzzo courts: Council of Ministers adopts bill to make them permanent
item.description: On 22 July 2025 the Council of Ministers approved the bill on the judicial map that makes the courts of Avezzano, Lanciano, Sulmona and Vasto permanent.

item.title: Abruzzo courts: towards a definitive reopening without extensions
item.description: The Milleproroghe decree does not extend the courts of Avezzano, Lanciano, Sulmona and Vasto: a bill on judicial geography is announced to reopen offices closed in 2012.

item.title: Visit to L’Aquila police headquarters in support of law enforcement
item.description: On 7 January 2025 senators Liris and Sigismondi met police chief De Simone in L’Aquila to express solidarity with law enforcement officers after the assaults they have suffered.

item.title: 2025 Budget Law: 15 million for Chieti and funds for coastal villages
item.description: The 2025 Budget Law presented at a press conference: 15 million for hydrogeological risk in Chieti and 500,000 euros a year from 2025 to 2027 for Abruzzo’s fishing industry and coastal villages.

item.title: Budget law in the Senate chamber: health, tax wedge and businesses
item.description: In the Senate Sigismondi outlines the budget: 136.5 billion for health, a 17-billion cut to the tax wedge and a 4% reduction of Ires (corporate income tax) for 18,000 companies.

item.title: Italian Capital of Sustainable Mobility: bill presented in the Senate
item.description: On 12 December 2023 a bill establishing the Italian Capital of Sustainable Mobility was presented in the Senate: a one-million-euro award and a three-year national plan.

item.title: FdI Abruzzo – regional elections: Chieti candidates presented
item.description: Sigismondi ” In Abruzzo we have strong, authoritative and competent candidates”. The candidates of Fratelli d’Italia were officially presented this morning for the…

item.title: Health fund: about 2.5 billion to Abruzzo, 75 million more than 2022
item.description: CIPESS (the interministerial committee for economic planning) has allocated about 2.5 billion euros to Abruzzo from the National Health Fund: over 75 million more than in 2022.

item.title: Strada dei Parchi: dispute settled through the advances decree
item.description: The Senate Budget Committee approves the amendment to the advances decree-law: Strada dei Parchi returns as A24-A25 concessionaire and tolls stay at 2017 levels.

item.title: Abruzzo courts: enabling law on the judicial map on its way
item.description: On 30 November 2023 Abruzzo mayors, provinces and bar councils meet the rapporteur of the courts decree: extension, staffing tables and an enabling law on the judicial map.

item.title: Revised PNRR cleared by the European Commission: a further 21 billion
item.description: The European Commission approved the revised PNRR (Italy’s National Recovery and Resilience Plan): a further 21 billion, 12.4 for businesses; reshaped projects keep their funding.

item.title: Abruzzo courts: new extension ahead of the judicial geography reform
item.description: New extension for the courts of Avezzano, Lanciano, Sulmona and Vasto, announced in the Senate Justice Committee on 22 November 2023; meeting with mayors and lawyers on 30 November.

item.title: Trabocchi: a bill for their protection and an exemption from Bolkestein
item.description: Presented in Pescara: the bill protecting the trabocchi and traditional fishing techniques, with an exemption from the Bolkestein directive for concessions. Sigismondi is first signatory.

item.title: Earthquake-zone schools: 528,000 euros to Abruzzo for exempted classes
item.description: The Ministry of Education funds classes exempt from the minimum pupil number in 2016 earthquake-zone schools: 528,184 euros to Abruzzo for the 2023/2024 school year.

item.title: Trabocchi, a bill to protect them and rebuild those that collapsed
item.description: Presented in Pescara on 17 August 2023, the bill on trabocchi: protection of the 32 existing ones, rebuilding of collapsed ones and exclusion from the EU directive on concessions.

item.title: Development and Cohesion Fund: over half a billion more for Abruzzo
item.description: A resolution of Cipess (the interministerial committee for economic planning and sustainable development) raises Abruzzo’s Development and Cohesion Fund by over half a billion.

item.title: Pescara-Roma: While the project takes shape thanks to the centre-right, the PD should say mea culpa
item.description: The culpable delays and the obstruction attempts of the centre-left count for nothing against the incisiveness of Marsilio and of the current national government”. I…

item.title: Abruzzo – Chieti PTCP. The centre-left did not take mayors and trade associations into account. The plan needs correcting.
item.description: The variant to the Provincial Territorial Coordination Plan (PTCP) adopted by the Province of Chieti, led by President Francesco Menna and the centre-left, was conceived…

item.title: Pescara-Rome railway: progress review on the lots in Avezzano after tenders
item.description: In Avezzano on 24 July 2023, the Abruzzo Region, RFI (Rete Ferroviaria Italiana), the commissioner and the deputy minister review the lots of the Pescara-Rome railway upgrade.

item.title: Our leadership class grows stronger. With seriousness, consistency, concreteness and credibility
item.description: I welcome with enthusiasm and great satisfaction the new members joining Fratelli d'Italia in the province of Chieti, in the persons of Tiziana Magnacca, former mayor of…

item.title: Pescara: demolition of the Ferro di Cavallo begins, a district reborn
item.description: On 3 July 2023 demolition work began on the Ferro di Cavallo in Pescara, the first step towards regenerating a district marked for years by decay and crime.

item.title: Pescara -Roma, Sigismondi, Liris and Testa (FdI): Government and region are moving ahead swiftly. The polemics of a frustrated centre-left wiped out.
item.description: “The launch of the tenders for the works relating to the doubling of the Pescara-Roma railway line crystallises an unequivocal fact. That the Meloni government and the…

item.title: Molise elections: Congratulations to Roberti. Ready to win in Abruzzo as well.
item.description: Congratulations to the new President of the Region, Francesco Roberti, and to the whole Molise centre-right for the important victory achieved. A weighty victory that…

item.title: Abruzzo courts: extra administrative staff now enshrined in law
item.description: The decree-law on public administration becomes law: administrative staff may now be added at the courts of Avezzano, Lanciano, Sulmona and Vasto.

item.title: Death of Silvio Berlusconi, the condolences of Fratelli d’Italia Abruzzo
item.description: On the death of Silvio Berlusconi Sigismondi expresses his personal condolences and those of Fratelli d’Italia Abruzzo, recalling his Government’s action after the L’Aquila earthquake.

item.title: Giro d’Italia in Abruzzo, from the Costa dei Trabocchi to Campo Imperatore
item.description: The opening stages of the 2023 Giro d’Italia crossed Abruzzo, from the Costa dei Trabocchi to Campo Imperatore: the Region banks on major sports events to promote tourism.

item.title: Safer Trignina: the MIT considers the works in the Anas multi-year plan
item.description: Answering a parliamentary question on 4 May 2023, the MIT (Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport) is considering including the Fondo Valle Trigno road in the Mit-Anas multi-year plan.

item.title: Bersaglieri: interregional rally marks 60 years of the Lanciano section
item.description: Abruzzo hosts the 5th interregional Bersaglieri rally for the 60th anniversary of the Lanciano section; the senator thanks the Corps for its work in Italy and abroad.
